title: MCP tools: filter_add and filter_remove for display object filters
description:
The JSFL layer already has doc.getFilters(), doc.addFilter(), doc.removeFilter(), doc.enableFilter(), doc.disableFilter() (added in task 1029 in runtime.ts). Wire these up as structured MCP tools:
1. filter_add: adds a filter to the currently selected display object(s). Params: type (string: 'dropShadow'|'glow'|'blur'|'bevel'|'gradientGlow'|'gradientBevel'|'colorMatrix'), plus optional filter-specific props (distance, angle, blurX, blurY, strength, quality, color, alpha, inner, knockout, hideObject for shadow/glow). Call doc.addFilter() via registry.
2. filter_remove: removes a filter by index from selected object(s). Params: index (number). Call doc.removeFilter() via registry.
3. filter_list: returns the list of filters on selected objects. Call doc.getFilters() via registry.
Add schemas to packages/agent-protocol/src/index.ts, handler to packages/authoring-ui/src/agent/registry.ts, MCP tool description to packages/vite-plugin-agent-mcp/src/index.ts.
Use stage_arrange or stage_update as structural template.
